svg.aria-label: Ten years, counted two different ways
svg.text: Ten years, counted two different ways
The AIMA wait counts, once the permit is granted
An application is not a title or a visa
Interrupted periods sum inside twelve years
Article 7(2) of Lei Orgânica 1/2026 keeps the previous text for files already pending on 19 May 2026.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 8 September 2026
